originality.rationale: The closest inspected 2018 triangle paper determines an area law for three side samples, and the inspected 2019 polytope paper determines expectation/asymptotics for iid pooled-boundary samples. A related triangular pointwise-depth calculation uses the same elementary corner probability, and previous quadrilateral area laws constrain only the integrated depth; neither supplies the full parallelogram coverage field or its two sharp and different endpoint level-area rates. Repeated semantic and targeted literal searches disclosed no equivalent statement, while unindexed coverage remains a risk.

value.rationale: The spatial depth distribution for a natural four-side random inscribed polygon is a distinct intrinsic geometric statistic: it detects robust coverage regions, not merely a scalar random hull area. The complete shape-independent field and sharp asymptotics reveal logarithmically thin weak-coverage edge layers versus a quadratic near-certain central region. Constants 4 and pi/4 describe geometrically motivated tails for every parallelogram; they are not implied by its mean half-area or earlier three-side area laws.
